title: 3.3 Am, Is, and Are
unit_outcome: Use tightly supported exchanges to give a name and limited age/origin/job information and describe simple possession.
goal: Choose am, is, or are for familiar singular, plural, and speaker pronouns in known sentence patterns.
grammar_function: I am; he/she/it is; you/we/they are. Affirmative only in this lesson.
prerequisite: 3.2 I/you/we frames plus Unit 1 he/she/they/is/are and Unit 2 it.
speaking_outcome: Repeat six mixed-subject sentences with the correct audible form of be.

cards.prompt: He is working. She is cooking.
